annotations.title: Scan a wallet for a launch kit

description: Whether a Solana wallet launched or traded memecoins with a known launch kit, with the verdict, the transactions that show it, the tokens the wallet launched and the wallets that funded it, walked up to its root funder with what Iris knows of that root. A token's mint scans its creator. Costs 5 credits, up to a number of scans a day set by the plan, or without an API key $0.25 paid per call with x402; refunded (never settled) if it fails. Can take up to two minutes.

mint.description: Optional: narrow the report to this token (base58 mint).

wallet.description: The Solana wallet (a dev or trader), or a token's mint to scan its creator (base58).
